display_ground_alignment.method: Two-bone leg IK for floor clearance; pelvis trajectory retained; bounded ankles; residual uniform clearance only; no vertex warping

commands.text: A person stands with feet apart, slowly squats down, then straightens the legs to stand up.

commands.text: A person marches in place with alternating high knees and coordinated arm swings.
commands.text_zh: 在原地交替抬高左右膝盖，双臂配合节奏摆动。

commands.text: A person kicks forward with the right leg, then brings the foot back and regains balance.
commands.text_zh: 重心落在左腿，抬起右腿向前踢出，再把右脚收回站稳。

commands.text: A person steps sideways with an upright torso and arms slightly spread for balance.
commands.text_zh: 上身直立，连续向侧面迈步，双臂自然展开以保持平衡。

surface.method: Twist-resolved skeletal IK; anatomical torso, neck and foot frames; neutral distal hands/head; bounded limb fitting; SO(3) display filtering followed by fresh skinning
surface.scope: Display retargeting only. Native motion features, source joints and original timing retained. Not an experimental motion-quality improvement.
surface.contact_ik: Source-ankle two-link IK with pelvis-aligned anatomical knee poles, strictly one-axis knees, bounded ankles and floor clearance; no vertex warping
